how: We read the website of every Portland wedding photographer listed on Lazo (140 listings, 113 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a makeup artist, a Florida-based destination photographer with a Portland listing, a barn venue and a DJ bundle listed as photographers, and studios whose sites lead with family or portrait work. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Most weddings here land in June through September; how do you shoot in flat gray light or rain the rest of the year, and can I see a full rainy-day gallery?
Is travel to the Gorge, wine country or the coast included, or billed separately?
How long until the full gallery arrives, and is a second photographer included or an add-on?

picks.name: Kate Holt Photography
picks.blurb: Kate Holt Photography is a team, not a solo shooter, offering high-end wedding photography in Portland, Seattle and beyond. The team makes a point of helping the day run smoothly, from building a timeline to organizing family portraits, and lays out its packages on a pricing page.

picks.name: Aralani Photography
picks.blurb: Sometimes in muddy boots, sometimes in heels: Aralani follows couples on romantic adventures all over the world, from catamarans and glacial lakes to ballrooms and mossy forests. A Portland wedding and elopement photographer who says the trust between her and each couple shows in the pictures.

picks.name: Tekoa Rose Photography
picks.blurb: Angela of Tekoa Rose Photography bills herself as a playful photographer for wonderful weirdos, with 16 years shooting candid weddings across Portland, Salem and the Oregon Coast. Every client gets a customized collection rather than a fixed menu.

picks.name: Taylor and Madye Photography
picks.blurb: High school sweethearts who have photographed Portland weddings for 11 years. Every Taylor and Madye package includes both of them working in tandem, two perspectives on the day plus help wrangling families, and the studio also offers video and film.

picks.name: Sean Carr Photography
picks.blurb: A film school graduate who worked as a set lighting tech before stumbling into weddings through a Craigslist ad. Sean Carr documents wild and adventurous love in the Pacific Northwest, often customizes packages, and includes a year of online gallery backup.

picks.name: Andie Avery Photography
picks.blurb: Based in Oregon and drawn to the road, Andie Avery photographs elopements and weddings in Oregon, Washington, Moab, Joshua Tree and Page, Arizona. Her most popular package is 8 hours with a complimentary engagement session and travel within most of Oregon, and she says her couples invest $6,000 on average.

picks.name: Lucia Wedding Photography
picks.blurb: Built for brides on a budget: Lucia Wedding Photography says not everybody can afford a premium wedding photographer, so it offers professional photography without the expensive bells and whistles. Local, experienced, and shooting across Oregon and Washington.

picks.name: Together Theory
picks.blurb: Kayla Dolce moved to Portland from New York in 2018 and has photographed weddings ever since, in a moody, true-to-color style that includes film. Together Theory publishes an Oregon elopement guide with packages, locations and a checklist.

picks.name: Here Today Photography
picks.blurb: Natalie discovered storytelling through images in 2010 as a Peace Corps volunteer in Central America. Here Today Photography documents the in-between moments of Portland weddings with natural, candid photos, guided portraits and true-to-life colors.

picks.name: Samantha Griggs Photography
picks.blurb: Honest imagery with an editorial feel, for lovers who want something a little different. Samantha Griggs prints her pricing: weddings start at $6,800 and elopements at $3,200, with a description of what each investment includes.

picks.name: Chris Brodell
picks.blurb: Chris and Jenny have worked together for almost a decade, first in the Bay Area and now in Portland, with Chris behind the camera and Jenny adding the aesthetic vision and the little extras. The site has a dedicated Portland wedding photography pricing page because, as they put it, pricing matters when choosing.

picks.name: Jesse Cobb Photography
picks.blurb: A Vancouver, Washington wedding and elopement photographer who spent nearly a decade in the US Navy's submarine force before settling in the Pacific Northwest with his wife and three children. Jesse Cobb's wedding and elopement packages are fully customizable.
